$comment: PRE-PUBLICATION AMENDMENT (2026-08-26): every ld.openhelvetia.org identifier was reminted to ld.openhelvetia.swiss in place, while nothing external consumes this artifact; immutability binds from first publication (standard README note, VERSIONING.md). Grounds: the sealed E03 Revisions-Nachtrag of 24.08.2026 makes openhelvetia.swiss the SINGLE public entry and ld.openhelvetia.swiss the home of the permanent identifiers — the remint is legal precisely because every affected artifact is still draft, and it must complete BEFORE publication.
title: OpenHelvetia agent-card signature envelope v0.1
description: Envelope carrying an A2A 1.0 agent card together with its two separated trust statements (E09 no. 5): 'authenticity' (the operator signed this card) and 'attestation' (the Verein verified the operator). The embedded card is additionally validated against the A2A 1.0 schema in a separate, mandatory step (E16 no. 6); this schema does not redefine A2A.

$schema.description: Head metadatum, manifest-standard convention: the dated, immutable schema URL of this envelope version.

a2aCard.description: The embedded A2A 1.0 agent card. Deliberately open (no additionalProperties constraint): its interior is defined by A2A 1.0, not by this spec, and strict A2A validation is a separate pipeline step. The properties below are a smoke check only. The 'signatures' member is forbidden here: inside the envelope the operator signature lives exclusively in 'authenticity'; the build step emits it into the served card's 'signatures' member.

protocolVersion.description: A2A protocol version the card conforms to.

url.description: Preferred endpoint URL of the agent (A2A); HTTPS only.

authenticity.description: Operator signature block: proves that whoever controls the domain-anchored key signed exactly this card (content integrity and key continuity — not legal entity, E09 no. 3). JWS signing input is built from JCS(card), RFC 8785.

signedAt.description: Operator-declared signing time (RFC 3339). A newly signed card is a re-verification event (E09 no. 2).

attestation.description: Verein verification block: proves that the association verified the operator out of band, at a stated level, at a stated time, with a stated expiry. JWS signing input is built from JCS({card, attestation-without-signature}), binding the claims to the exact card verified.

level.description: Verification level (gradient, never a binary badge — E14(b)). 'countersigned': the Verein verified identity out of band and countersigns for an operator without own key management (E09 no. 4). 'identity-verified': the out-of-band key-to-legal-entity binding was checked. 'deep-verified': additionally the credential-path deep check passed (E14(b)2).

expiresAt.description: Expiry of this attestation (RFC 3339). Expiry moves the entry along the lifecycle gradient (grace, then quarantine) — it never delists.

detachedJws.description: Detached JWS: protected header and signature only; the payload is reconstructed by the verifier via JCS (RFC 8785) from the content it actually received. The protected header must contain 'alg' (ES256 or EdDSA; never 'none', never symmetric) and 'kid' equal to keyRef.kid — enforced by the verifier, not expressible here.

keyRef.description: Key discovery reference: a JWK Set under the signing organisation's own domain well-known (DNS+TLS anchor, E09 no. 1) plus the key id within it.

jwksUri.description: HTTPS URL of the JWK Set on the organisation's domain (for OpenHelvetia-hosted organisations: the jwks_uri of /.well-known/openhelvetia.json, E16 no. 6).

kid.description: Key id selecting the key within the JWK Set.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, UTC ('Z') required. The pattern enforces the shape; 'format' is annotation-only in draft 2020-12.
